shared_elements: disc or circular boss in relief at the top
curved/arched band or pair of curved lines beneath the disc
shallow incised outline relief on a stela-like slab
a field below the arch containing carved motifs
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive upper scheme of a round-topped slab crowned by a disc set above a pair of sweeping curved bands (a winged-disc-like lunette motif) with a recessed scene field beneath, rendered in the same shallow outline relief. The decisive difference is that B's field contains a legible pair of confronted standing figures in profile flanking a central emblem with columns of sign-writing, whereas A's field shows only faint, ambiguous incised marks with no identifiable figures, so the shared content is confined to the framing scheme.
